verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only makes a general claim that 'every feature ships a CPU path first' (localai-docs-27) but never mentions AVX, AVX2, AVX512, or AMX instruction sets specifically, nor any CPU optimization flags or backend selection logic for these instruction sets. Missing for 10: any explicit documentation of AVX/AVX2/AVX512/AMX support, build flags, or benchmarks showing performance gains from these instruction sets.
